enhanceLong.markdown:
## Summary

The beta build has passed QA and will be shipped to customers on Friday. Pricing remains at $40 per seat for now, with a formal review planned for January. The customer from Northwind raised concerns about the $40 per seat price being too high for small teams, prompting an open question about offering an annual discount. Priya is committed to writing release notes by Thursday, and Me is committed to updating the pricing page before launch. A referral program is suggested for future consideration but no commitment has been made.

## Beta Launch Status

- The beta build has passed QA and the team agrees to ship the beta to customers on Friday. [00:18](#t=18000) [01:18](#t=78000) [02:18](#t=138000)
